Can the origination fee be waived, reduced, or paid up front instead of financed?
Can the late charge be a flat amount, with no rate increase after a late payment?
Will you limit the security interest to the equipment itself, not all of my business assets?
Can disputes be handled in my home state instead of the venue named here?
Will you remove the prepayment premium so I can pay this off early without a penalty?
Can the cross-default clause be limited to obligations owed to you, not to any creditor?
Can I use my own insurer? What does your insurance program actually cost per month?
